title: Class Pack as default for class-scoped generations
description: When a worksheet is generated in Auto-from-class mode (PR-2), automatically run it through the existing Class Pack pipeline so each pupil receives a tier-appropriate, named copy in one printable PDF. Add A5 booklet imposition and a greyscale-friendly print theme to pdf-generator-v2.
rationale: The everyday teacher motion is: print once, walk to the photocopier once, hand out in register order. Today Class Pack exists but is opt-in and several clicks deep. Making it the default for class-scoped generations completes the 'we know your class' promise.
steps: In client/src/pages/worksheets/useWorksheetGeneration.ts (from PR-0/PR-2), after a successful generateFromBrief call, automatically chain into runClassPack from client/src/lib/class-pack.ts. Do NOT auto-chain for manual generations — only for class-scoped Auto generations.
Defaults applied automatically (teacher can still tweak before printing):
- Differentiate per pupil = ON (use brief.pupilSummaries to set per-pupil tier)
- Print as named booklet = ON (pupil name on cover, register order)
Surface the result via the existing ClassPackDialog (do not auto-open the print window — open the dialog so the teacher confirms).
Extend client/src/lib/pdf-generator-v2.ts (or whichever module renders the printable HTML — grep for buildClassPackHtml in client/src/lib/class-pack.ts and trace from there) with two new options:
- imposition: 'A4' | 'A5-booklet'  (A5-booklet halves the page and reorders for saddle-stitch)
- theme: 'colour' | 'greyscale-print'  (greyscale-print swaps coloured backgrounds for hatched fills and removes background tints; tested at 300dpi photocopier)
Add toggles for both new options to ClassPackDialog under a 'Print options' collapsible. Default: A4 + colour, matching today.
Persist the teacher's last-used imposition + theme in UserPreferencesContext (`classPackImposition`, `classPackTheme`).
Update client/src/components/WorksheetActionsBar.tsx (introduced by PR-0) so the Class Pack button is visually de-emphasised in Auto mode (tooltip: 'Already prepared'), and prominent in Manual mode.
Add a test client/src/lib/__tests__/pdfImposition.test.ts that asserts A5-booklet ordering for an 8-page input matches the expected saddle-stitch sequence (1,8,2,7,...).
Add a Storybook-style visual regression spec or snapshot for the greyscale theme if one is already configured (search for `*.stories.*` and `*.snap`); skip if none.
files_to_touch: client/src/lib/class-pack.ts (small additions only — pass-through for new options)
do_not_touch: buildClassAutoBrief or aiGenerateWorksheetFromClassBrief (already shipped in PR-1)
AutoFromClassPanel.tsx (already shipped in PR-2 — only consume its result)
acceptance_criteria: Auto-mode generation auto-runs the Class Pack pipeline and opens ClassPackDialog with sensible defaults; teacher can still cancel.
Manual-mode generation behaviour is identical to before this PR.
A5-booklet imposition produces a correctly-ordered saddle-stitch PDF for a 4 / 8 / 16 / 24 page input.
Greyscale-print theme has zero coloured backgrounds and is legible at 300dpi photocopier output (manual visual check).
Last-used imposition and theme persist across reloads.
pnpm run check + pnpm run build pass; new test passes.
verification: Manual: generate from Auto for a real class; print to PDF in greyscale + A5-booklet; verify pages collate correctly.
context_budget_for_fresh_chat: MEDIUM. ClassPackDialog is 475 lines (read in full). class-pack.ts is the heaviest existing file you'll touch — read its exports list with grep first, then read only the buildClassPackHtml + runClassPack ranges.
